scripts.generate-types-check: (npx openapi-typescript openapi.yaml --output src/types.generated.ts && if ! cmp -s src/types.generated.ts src/types.ts; then rm src/types.generated.ts; echo 'Generated types differ from committed types. Run "pnpm --filter packages/shared-api... run generate-types" and commit the result.'; exit 1; else rm src/types.generated.ts; fi)
